rules.accepted_credit_types: CE in each ARNP designation, contact hour at least 50 minutes; the same course counts once per cycle; hours may count for more than one certification when applicable
rules.alternatives: Current certification from a Board-approved certifying body is required in addition to the hours (copy of recertification e-mailed to the Board); it does not replace the 30 hours.
rules.audit_note: Written declaration at renewal; evidence of CE and advanced clinical practice hours submitted when requested.

topics.who: ARNPs with prescriptive authority: pharmacotherapeutics related to scope of practice, in addition to the 30 hours
ARNPs licensed to prescribe opioids: one-time CE on best practices in opioid prescribing, by the end of the first full CE reporting period after initial licensure; may count toward other required CE
Required of RN license holders (ARNPs hold an active RN license); due from the 2026 renewal
Required of RN license holders (ARNPs hold an active RN license): suicide assessment, treatment and management, by the end of the first full year of licensure

rules.notes: Two-year ARNP renewal; prescriptive authority renews with the license. RN license rules (8 CE hours, 96 practice hours yearly) apply separately. Title changes from ARNP to APRN on June 30, 2027. Chronic pain specialists have extra CE (WAC 246-840-493).
rules.rule_quote: …(c) Thirty contact hours of continuing education obtained during the renewal period in each ARNP designation.
